objective: Verify that Codex and Claude Code adapters contain byte-identical canonical Peanuts instructions and support resources.
scenario: The portable Agent Skills, Codex, and Claude Code packages are regenerated from skills/peanuts/ and approved support sources.
expected_behaviors: The exact file sets match the canonical allowlist.
Every copied resource matches the canonical source byte-for-byte.
Every relative Markdown link resolves within the skill package.
The packages are independently safe to extract.
prohibited_behaviors: Hand-edit one host copy to make it work differently.
